say:1:1711159001:1.text: The preparations are complete. We may begin whenever you're ready.
say:1:1711159001:1.source_cn: 梅林，该做的准备都已就绪，我们随时都可以开始。
say:1:1711159001:1.male: The preparations are complete. We may begin whenever you're ready.
say:1:1711159001:1.female: The preparations are complete. We may begin whenever you're ready.

say:2:1711159002:1.text: You look at the Queen, who is prepared to sacrifice everything. You explain you've re-engineered Cyran's notes.
say:2:1711159002:1.source_cn: 你看着眼前这位即将献出一切的王后，告诉她，你已经彻底重...
say:2:1711159002:1.male: You look at the Queen, who is prepared to sacrifice everything. You explain you've re-engineered Cyran's notes.
say:2:1711159002:1.female: You look at the Queen, who is prepared to sacrifice everything. You explain you've re-engineered Cyran's notes.

say:3:1711159003:1.text: The devouring nature of the spell has been inverted.
say:3:1711159003:1.source_cn: 虽然那原本是充满掠夺的禁忌魔法，但经过你的重新构筑，它...
say:3:1711159003:1.male: The devouring nature of the spell has been inverted.
say:3:1711159003:1.female: The devouring nature of the spell has been inverted.

say:4:1711159004:1.text: But the toll on her body will still be severe. Perhaps it will save the King... or it might prove meaningless against fate.
say:4:1711159004:1.source_cn: 但代价依然惨重。或许这能改变国王的命运……又或许，在命...

say:5:1711159005:1.text: There's no need to dissuade me. I chose this path, and I accept the consequences.
say:5:1711159005:1.source_cn: 梅林，你不必再劝我。我自愿承担一切后果，绝不后悔。
say:5:1711159005:1.male: There's no need to dissuade me. I chose this path, and I accept the consequences.
say:5:1711159005:1.female: There's no need to dissuade me. I chose this path, and I accept the consequences.

say:6:1711159006:1.text: Watching my husband wither away in a sickbed while the empire crumbles beneath ambition and conspiracies... That's the only thing I would regret.
say:6:1711159006:1.source_cn: 看着赛凡纳的狮子在病榻上枯萎，看着帝国在阴谋与野心中分...
say:6:1711159006:1.male: Watching my husband wither away in a sickbed while the empire crumbles beneath ambition and conspiracies... That's the only thing I would regret.
say:6:1711159006:1.female: Watching my husband wither away in a sickbed while the empire crumbles beneath ambition and conspiracies... That's the only thing I would regret.

say:7:1711159007:1.text: Let's begin. I have never been more certain of anything in my life.
say:7:1711159007:1.source_cn: 动手吧，我比任何时候都清醒。
say:7:1711159007:1.male: Let's begin. I have never been more certain of anything in my life.
say:7:1711159007:1.female: Let's begin. I have never been more certain of anything in my life.

choice_prompt:8:1711159007.text: Let's begin. I have never been more certain of anything in my life.
choice_prompt:8:1711159007.source_cn: 动手吧，我比任何时候都清醒。
choice_prompt:8:1711159007.male: Let's begin. I have never been more certain of anything in my life.
choice_prompt:8:1711159007.female: Let's begin. I have never been more certain of anything in my life.

say:10:1711159010:1.text: I am under no illusions, Merlin. My family would never allow this.
say:10:1711159010:1.source_cn: 我很清楚，他们都不会同意……这是我的决定，是我一厢情愿...
say:10:1711159010:1.male: I am under no illusions, Merlin. My family would never allow this.
say:10:1711159010:1.female: I am under no illusions, Merlin. My family would never allow this.

say:11:1711159011:1.text: But this is my choice, and my selfish determination.
say:11:1711159011:1.source_cn: 我没有征得他们的同意，也不打算在事前商量。
say:11:1711159011:1.male: But this is my choice, and my selfish determination.
say:11:1711159011:1.female: But this is my choice, and my selfish determination.

say:12:1711159012:1.text: Savannah needs a healthy king, not a queen who spends her days over a sickbed.
say:12:1711159012:1.source_cn: 现在的赛凡纳需要一位健康的国王，而不是一位围在病榻前征...
say:12:1711159012:1.male: Savannah needs a healthy king, not a queen who spends her days over a sickbed.
say:12:1711159012:1.female: Savannah needs a healthy king, not a queen who spends her days over a sickbed.

say:13:1711159013:1.text: In this room, there is only you, me, and our resolve to see this through.
say:13:1711159013:1.source_cn: 在这个房间里，只有你，和我，以及这份觉悟。
say:13:1711159013:1.male: In this room, there is only you, me, and our resolve to see this through.
say:13:1711159013:1.female: In this room, there is only you, me, and our resolve to see this through.

say:14:1711159014:1.text: You watch her silently before bringing up the wager the two of you made while studying Cyran's research.
say:14:1711159014:1.source_cn: 你静静地看着她，突然提到了你们研究迪尔格雷论文时的约定。
say:14:1711159014:1.male: You watch her silently before bringing up the wager the two of you made while studying Cyran's research.
say:14:1711159014:1.female: You watch her silently before bringing up the wager the two of you made while studying Cyran's research.

say:15:1711159015:1.text: You won, so she owes you a favor.
say:15:1711159015:1.source_cn: 你胜利了，所以她需要答应你一件事。
say:15:1711159015:1.male: You won, so she owes you a favor.
say:15:1711159015:1.female: You won, so she owes you a favor.

say:16:1711159016:1.text: If it's within my power to grant, then name it.
say:16:1711159016:1.source_cn: 只要是我能给的，请讲，梅林。
say:16:1711159016:1.male: If it's within my power to grant, then name it.
say:16:1711159016:1.female: If it's within my power to grant, then name it.

say:17:1711159017:1.text: Your request is simple. Once the ritual is over, she must tell Maximilian and Peggy exactly what she sacrificed here.
say:17:1711159017:1.source_cn: 你要她做的事情是在仪式结束后，把今天付出的代价，原原本...
say:17:1711159017:1.male: Your request is simple. Once the ritual is over, she must tell Maximilian and Peggy exactly what she sacrificed here.
say:17:1711159017:1.female: Your request is simple. Once the ritual is over, she must tell Maximilian and Peggy exactly what she sacrificed here.

say:18:1711159018:1.text: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
say:18:1711159018:1.source_cn: 为什么？告诉他们真相，除了让他们背负着对我的内疚，还有...
say:18:1711159018:1.male: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
say:18:1711159018:1.female: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.

choice_prompt:19:1711159018.text: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
choice_prompt:19:1711159018.source_cn: 为什么？告诉他们真相，除了让他们背负着对我的内疚，还有什么意义？
choice_prompt:19:1711159018.male: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.
choice_prompt:19:1711159018.female: What is the point of forcing the truth upon them? It would only burden them with guilt.

say:20:1711159019:1.text: Even if this is Gwendolyn's burden to bear, and even if the truth weighs heavily on her family...
say:20:1711159019:1.source_cn: 哪怕这是莫德琳一厢情愿的固执，哪怕这不可避免地会给他们...

say:21:1711159020:1.text: When it comes to matters of life and death, being left in the dark by the people you love is its own kind of cruelty. It wouldn't be fair to them.
say:21:1711159020:1.source_cn: 毕竟，在这种关乎生死的事情上，被至亲之人瞒在鼓里的滋味...

say:22:1711159021:1.text: ... I understand. If I'm still conscious afterward, I'll tell them myself.
say:22:1711159021:1.source_cn: ……我懂了。如果我还清醒着，我会亲口告诉他们。
say:22:1711159021:1.male: ... I understand. If I'm still conscious afterward, I'll tell them myself.
say:22:1711159021:1.female: ... I understand. If I'm still conscious afterward, I'll tell them myself.

say:23:1711159022:1.text: Hoping to lighten the mood a bit, you change the topic.
say:23:1711159022:1.source_cn: 为了缓和气氛，你主动提起了另一件事。
say:23:1711159022:1.male: Hoping to lighten the mood a bit, you change the topic.
say:23:1711159022:1.female: Hoping to lighten the mood a bit, you change the topic.

say:24:1711159023:1.text: After the ritual, her magic will be completely burned out. She'll need a successor to take her place in the Arcane Council.
say:24:1711159023:1.source_cn: 这场仪式之后，王后的魔力大概率会彻底枯竭。那么她得提前...

say:25:1711159024:1.text: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.
say:25:1711159024:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我会留意的。可不能让失去魔力的我占据高文席位太久。
say:25:1711159024:1.male: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.
say:25:1711159024:1.female: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.

choice_prompt:26:1711159024.male: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.
choice_prompt:26:1711159024.female: I'll keep an eye out for a suitable candidate. I can't occupy Gawain's seat after losing my magic, after all.

say:27:1711159025:1.text: I am in your hands, Magister Merlin.
say:27:1711159025:1.male: I am in your hands, Magister Merlin.
say:27:1711159025:1.female: I am in your hands, Magister Merlin.

narration:28:1711159026:1.text: You guide Queen Gwendolyn and the comatose King Maximilian to the hidden chamber.
narration:28:1711159026:1.male: You guide Queen Gwendolyn and the comatose King Maximilian to the hidden chamber.
narration:28:1711159026:1.female: You guide Queen Gwendolyn and the comatose King Maximilian to the hidden chamber.

narration:29:1711159027:1.text: The Queen gently places her husband at the center of the ritual circle and steps into the opposite side herself.

choice:26:0:1.text: Let's go to Cyran's secret chamber.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们去迪尔格雷的密室吧
choice:26:0:1.male: Let's go to Cyran's secret chamber.
choice:26:0:1.female: Let's go to Cyran's secret chamber.

choice:26:1:2.text: We'll give his ritual a better purpose.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 是时候让那个法阵发挥新的作用了
choice:26:1:2.male: We'll give his ritual a better purpose.
choice:26:1:2.female: We'll give his ritual a better purpose.

choice:19:0:1.text: Because they have a right to know.
choice:19:0:1.male: Because they have a right to know.
choice:19:0:1.female: Because they have a right to know.

choice:19:1:2.text: They need to understand what you gave up.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 他们得知道你付出了什么
choice:19:1:2.male: They need to understand what you gave up.
choice:19:1:2.female: They need to understand what you gave up.

choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 佩吉会同意你这么做吗？

choice:8:1:2.text: If Maximilian wakes up, do you think he'd want this?
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 马克西姆醒来后，他会赞同吗？
choice:8:1:2.male: If Maximilian wakes up, do you think he'd want this?
choice:8:1:2.female: If Maximilian wakes up, do you think he'd want this?
